# Introduction

The chapters follow the order in which the work was done.

- Inputs: the ZMA, IBTrACS storm tracks and IMERG rainfall, then a first look at wind against rainfall for past storms.
- A first, observational-only optimization using IBTrACS and IMERG, and a look at ERA5 soil moisture at landfall.
- The main trigger chapter (Visualize Options). It filters the candidate forecast and observational combinations, shows the options put to the working group, and adds a readiness stage to the chosen option.
- CHIRPS-GEFS: how the forecast rainfall rasters are downloaded, clipped to Cuba and summarised.
- Appendices: a check that the monitoring code computes the same rainfall quantiles as the historical analysis, a comparison of WorldPop with official population figures, and a map of one storm's wind footprint over population.

Code is folded by default. Click "Code" above an output to see what produced it.
